Method of Attack: Exploits Log4Shell vulnerability in Apache Log4j to download and execute malicious Java class

Uses valid encryption but ransom note lacks legitimate contact information, suggesting possible wiper behavior
Attack Vector: Log4Shell exploit via crafted JNDI strings causing Log4j to load remote code

Ransom note and encrypted file extension named 'Khonsari'
